title: Mack and Sheehan's plan to train repeat abductees with holotropic breathing
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Mack and Sheehan's plan to train repeat abductees with holotropic breathing, about before 2004 at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we started deciding that what we wanted to do is help train people uh that had consistent repeated encounters

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that before 2004 he and a Harvard psychiatrist, John Mack, who studied people reporting alien abductions, planned to train people who had repeated encounters with non-human beings. Sheehan says the training was to use holotropic breathing, a deep, fast breathing method meant to bring on altered states of mind. The idea, as he tells it, was to help these people handle and perhaps guide their encounters.
